notes:
I couldn't write these notes. I wasn't able to read any of the commentary pages, and your rules say not to fill gaps from my own knowledge, so there are no verse notes below.

**What happened**
- I tried to open four sources at once: Enduring Word on Proverbs 10, Precept Austin's Proverbs 10 commentary, the Bible Hub commentary page for 10:1 (Gill, Ellicott, Pulpit and others), and a StudyLight commentary on Proverbs 10.
- The requests ran, but my code broke while reading the results, so none of the page text came through.
- Before I could fix it, I hit the limit on research tool calls for this turn. I couldn't search or open anything else.

**Next turn I would:**
1. **Traditional reading:** go through enduringword.com, preceptaustin.org, and the Bible Hub and StudyLight pages verse by verse.
2. **Protestant differences:** check the tradition-specific sites (Ligonier, Desiring God, GTY, Wesley Center, Seedbed, LCMS, 1517 and others). This matters most for verses like 2 ("righteousness brings deliverance from death"), 12 ("love covers all transgressions"), 22 ("the blessing of the LORD enriches") and 27 ("the fear of the LORD prolongs life").
3. **Other views:** read the NET Bible notes and bibleodyssey.org for modern scholarship; newadvent.org, catholic.com and oca.org for Catholic and Orthodox readings; and gotquestions.org and similar sites on how prosperity teaching uses verses 4, 15, 16 and 22.

You'd get "v. X: …" notes with a URL after every point, and verses I couldn't find anything on would be left out. Just reply "continue" and I'll start again.
